description:
Use this to run a saved Sidekick action by name in the user's open InDesign document. An action is JavaScript the user (or Sidekick) saved earlier, with a header that names it, describes it and types its params.

Pass the params as one object; leave a param out to use its default. The answer is the action's report as text (summary, rows, what a changeCount means for this run's mode), any problems the report has, its log, and the report as JSON with at most 200 rows. When an action fails, the answer carries the error, the stack (lines refer to the action's file) and the numbered source, so a fix needs no second call. Fix the action, run it again, and ask the user before saving the fix. An action with an apply param is not finished until both modes have run; ask the user before a trial run with the param on, and undo it afterwards with Edit › Undo when the answer shows an Undo line; without one, run the trial on a copy of the document instead, as an older Sidekick plugin does not make the run one undo step.

Actions as of the last scan: alt-text-audit (built-in), dutch-typography (built-in), overset-hunt (built-in), rich-black-sweep (built-in). list_actions reads the folders fresh and shows the params; call it when a name you expect is missing.

name.description: The action's name, as this description or list_actions gives it

params.description: The action's params by name; leave one out to use its default

name: run_action
